text_or_filename: Real Riders were a concept developed by Bob Rosas and Larry Wood to appeal to the adult collector. Bob Rosas , Hot Wheels Designer and Engineer 1969-1989, has said that, "We were aware that many older collectors, really liked the realistic aspects of Hot Wheels, and real rubber tires and white lettering with mag style wheels were a natural."
